verdict.rationale: Orb ships several autonomous background processes—automatic dunning retries (orb-docs-19,33), automatic invoice issuance after grace periods (orb-docs-21), automatic credit top-ups (orb-docs-37), usage-threshold alerts (orb-docs-6,29), and real-time webhooks (orb-docs-23)—all of which run without manual intervention. However, these are billing-domain automations rather than general-purpose, user-configured autonomous workflows or AI-agent orchestration; there's no evidence of a broader automation/workflow builder for arbitrary background tasks. Missing for 10: evidence of a general-purpose automation/workflow engine beyond billing triggers, and any AI-agent-specific autonomous task execution.
